evidenceIndex.format: One JSON record per essential headword; first raw occurrence per chapter, exact chapter and normalized-original UTF-16 token/quote offsets, no generated definitions.

limits: The original historical novel includes dialect, older vocabulary and historical social views. Orthographic occurrence is not an endorsement or a current standard-language teaching example.
B2–C1 is an uncalibrated AI content estimate retained from the source manifest, not a CEFR or IELTS calibration.
Fiction is not a scientific or medical authority. No new target-word senses, grammar evidence or explanations are inferred from it.

The Gutenberg text and LibriVox recordings can use different editions. Chapter/catalog identity and MP3 byte hashes do not establish word-for-word audio/text alignment, acoustic accent, or independent listening validation.
Printed chapter 27 has two original audio segments. They remain one unique reading source; audio counts do not duplicate vocabulary coverage.

Exact whole tokens, explicit source-listed inflections and recorded spelling variants are matched. Names, homographs and target senses remain unverified; ambiguous lemma matches are marked. Dialect spellings are not guessed into modern lemmas.
Chapter headings, the terminal THE END marker, ebook front matter and the original license/postmatter do not add narrative word coverage.
The frozen delivered baseline is unchanged. This report does not activate lessons, assign daily new-word amounts, establish exposure/mastery, or modify learner records.
Rights and narrator identity labels are inherited from the publisher catalogue and preserved original source; this audit checks their file identities, not a new legal or acoustic certification.
